chapter: Union, publishers, race and Harlem nightlife
title: White bands at the Savoy Ballroom
summary: White bands played the Savoy in the early 1930s and about ten percent of the dancers were white.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands

blocks.x: When was this? It must have been sometime in the 30's no doubt.
Early 30's? Did you mean they had white bands up at the Savoy?
These were white bands playing for almost black audiences?
Playing for anybody. Sure, they'd dance together, just like you walk and talk in the street today.
Not too many white went up there though.
No, there wasn't too many whites, but the white people would come up there.
Would you say there were 10% white?
I'd say around about 10%, yes I would, maybe more.
